_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree current phase is Complacency and current action is HOLD, but they split on forward implication: Analyst sees divergence invalidating the bottom analog; Narrative sees compression foreshadowing a sharp resolution without specifying direction
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows climb above 30 and stablecoin growth turns positive, confirming Disbelief recovery continuation
